forms.title: New Client Onboarding
forms.description: Collect personal, financial, and regulatory information for new advisory clients.

fields.label: Welcome to Client Onboarding
fields.description: This form collects personal, financial, and regulatory information required to open your advisory account. All data is kept confidential and secure.

fields.label: Age
fields.description: Used for risk assessment and suitability calculations.

fields.label: Investment Time Horizon (years)
fields.description: 1 = Less than 1 year, 15 = Medium-term, 30 = 30+ years.

fields.label: Risk Tolerance
fields.description: 1 = Very conservative (prefer safety), 10 = Very aggressive (accept high volatility).

fields.label: Risk Score
fields.description: Weighted score (1-100) based on age, investment horizon, and risk tolerance.

fields.label: Accredited Investor Status
fields.description: SEC Rule 501(a): income > $200k or net worth > $1M.

fields.label: Suggested Portfolio Allocation
fields.description: Equity:Bond:Cash ratio based on risk score.

fields.label: Onboarding Complete
fields.description: Thank you for completing the onboarding form. Your advisor will review the information and reach out with next steps.

forms.title: Risk Tolerance Questionnaire
forms.description: Assess client risk tolerance and generate a suitability profile for regulatory compliance.

fields.label: Client Age
fields.description: Confirm the client's current age for suitability calculations.

fields.label: Annual Income ($)
fields.description: Confirm the client's annual income for suitability analysis.

fields.label: Net Worth ($)
fields.description: Confirm the client's total net worth.

fields.label: Investment Time Horizon (years)
fields.description: 1 = Less than 1 year, 30 = 30+ years.

fields.label: If the market dropped 20% tomorrow, what would you do?
How much portfolio loss can you absorb without affecting your lifestyle?
fields.description: 1 = Very little (< 5%), 10 = Significant (> 40%).

fields.label: Recommended Portfolio Type
fields.description: Select the portfolio type to validate against the suitability score.

fields.label: Risk Profile Score
fields.description: Weighted suitability score (1-100) based on age, income, net worth, tolerance, and horizon.

fields.label: Reg BI Suitability Check
fields.description: Validates that the selected portfolio type is suitable for this client's risk profile.

properties.calculationExpression: risk_profile_score >= 70 && (portfolio_type == "conservative" || portfolio_type == "moderate") ? "Review needed" : risk_profile_score < 30 && (portfolio_type == "aggressive" || portfolio_type == "speculative") ? "Review needed" : "Suitable"

forms.title: ACAT / Transfer Form
forms.description: Initiate an Automated Customer Account Transfer (ACAT) from an external custodian.

forms.title: Form CRS & Relationship Summary
forms.description: Client Relationship Summary disclosure required by SEC regulation.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: This Client Relationship Summary ("Form CRS") is required by the SEC and provides important information about our firm, services, fees, conflicts of interest, and disciplinary history. Please review each section carefully before signing.

fields.label: What investment services and advice can you provide me?
fields.description: We provide investment advisory services including portfolio management, financial planning, and retirement planning. We offer both discretionary and non-discretionary account management. Account minimums and other requirements may apply.

fields.label: What fees will I pay?
fields.description: Our fees are based on a percentage of assets under management (AUM), charged quarterly in arrears. The more assets you have in your account, the more you will pay in fees, giving us an incentive to encourage you to increase your account size. You may also incur brokerage, custody, and fund expense charges.

fields.label: What are your legal obligations to me?
fields.description: When we act as your investment adviser, we must act in your best interest and not place our interests ahead of yours. We are held to a fiduciary standard under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940.

fields.label: Do you or your financial professionals have legal or disciplinary history?
fields.description: Visit Investor.gov/CRS to research our firm and financial professionals. You can also ask us: "As a financial professional, do you have any disciplinary history? If so, for what type of conduct?"

forms.title: Annual Client Review
forms.description: Document annual portfolio review, updated goals, and any life changes for each client.

fields.label: Current Annual Fee
fields.description: Tiered advisory fee based on current AUM.

fields.label: Goal Progress
fields.description: 1 = Significantly behind, 5 = On track, 10 = Exceeding goals.

fields.label: Updated Risk Tolerance
fields.description: 1 = Very conservative, 10 = Very aggressive. Leave unchanged if risk profile has not shifted.

forms.title: Fee Agreement
forms.description: Establish advisory fee terms based on assets under management.

forms.title: Document Vault
forms.description: Securely store and organize client documents such as tax returns, statements, and legal files.

properties.placeholder: Enter a name for this document

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.description: Applicable for documents with an expiration (insurance policies, legal agreements, etc.).

forms.description: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification.

Business name / disregarded entity name, if different

validation.message: Please enter a valid SSN (###-##-####) or EIN (##-#######).

properties.placeholder: Number, street, city, state, ZIP code

forms.title: Beneficiary Designation
forms.description: Designate primary and contingent beneficiaries for an investment account.

forms.title: Power of Attorney
forms.description: Grant legal authority to an agent to act on the principal's behalf in specified matters.

properties.placeholder: Full legal name of the principal
Full legal name of the agent

forms.title: 1035 Exchange
forms.description: Facilitate a tax-free exchange of an existing life insurance or annuity policy for a new one.

properties.placeholder: e.g. Term, Whole Life, Variable Annuity

fields.label: Are there surrender charges on the existing policy?
Surrender Charges ($)
fields.description: Enter the estimated surrender charge amount if applicable.

forms.title: Rollover Form
forms.description: Initiate a rollover of retirement plan assets from an employer plan or existing IRA.

fields.label: Roth Conversion Tax Notice
fields.description: Converting pre-tax retirement assets to a Roth account is a taxable event. The converted amount will be added to your gross income for the tax year. Please consult a tax professional before proceeding.

properties.placeholder: Name of current plan custodian or administrator
Name of custodian receiving the rollover

fields.label: Receiving Account Number
fields.description: Leave blank if a new account will be opened.

fields.label: Direct or Indirect Rollover
fields.description: Direct: funds transfer custodian-to-custodian. Indirect: funds sent to you, must be redeposited within 60 days.

fields.label: 60-Day Rollover Deadline
fields.description: With an indirect rollover, you must deposit the funds into a qualifying retirement account within 60 calendar days. Failure to do so may result in the distribution being treated as taxable income plus a 10% early withdrawal penalty if under age 59½.
